rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Laura-san! You looked really
cool at the award ceremony!

rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0002
rows.name:
It was a special ceremony, so I left
the inn to Dad and went to watch with
all my friends.

rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I was still a bit late
for it, though...

rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I couldn't decide what to wear, and
Joey kept complaining about it.

rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I know I was at fault! But I couldn't
wear my usual clothes on Laura-san's
important day.

rows.label: tlk70000005_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I just wanted it to be a super nice
day! Joey, you idiot! Idiot, idiot!!
